{{Quote|Obi-Wan is in your vicinity aboard the attack cruiser, ''Liberation''. He and his troops will arrive shortly to aid you in preventing this genocide&mdash;and to assist you in taking Ja'Boag into custody.|[[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], to [[Judd]]|<ref name="Darth Maul—Death Sentence 3">[[Darth Maul — Death Sentence 3|''Darth Maul — Death Sentence'' 3]]</ref>}}
The '''''Liberation''''' was a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] in service of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Marshal Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] assumed command of the ''Liberation'' to search for the recently returned [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. When [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Judd]] reported encountering Maul on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Moorjhone]] along with Master [[Salmara]] and her [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Dray (Fallen Jedi)|Dray]], Kenobi and Cody brought the ''Liberation'' to Moorjhone to provide reinforcements in the form of their embarked [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] from the [[212th Attack Battalion/Legends|212th Attack Battalion]].
